_rationale: V1 gets 1.784 vs benchmark CPTransformer 0.515 — catastrophic gap (1.27).
MicroV1 is even more prone to overfitting on this tiny heterogeneous dataset
because it has fewer parameters and less capacity to handle distribution shift.
1. LR 0.0001 — very low to avoid divergence on noisy Zn-ion landscape.
2. batch_size=16 + accum=2 — smaller batch, same effective size for BN.
3. dropout=0.15 — strong regularization for the micro architecture.
5. patience=20 — long patience since plateaus are common on ZN-coin.
